pass_timing_diagnostic.method: Test-only gl.finish plus one-pixel readPixels on the surface framebuffer before timing the shade pass. Both passes use unmodified production sources.

excluded_anomalous_run.reason: Surface timing lacked a framebuffer readback and reported an implausible near-zero duration; retained only as raw audit evidence.

limitations: SwiftShader series is software rendering and is not physical-GPU FPS.
RTX results are from one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti D3D11 host and include high run-to-run shader-link and frame-time variance.
Fresh browser processes do not imply a cold driver cache; the benchmark did not clear the driver shader cache.
Nearest-rank p95 equals worst for n=5 and n=10.
WORKTREE source identity is recorded by per-pass FNV-1a shader hashes; it is not a Git commit.
